mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, main_id, next_level_id, last_time, next_time, interval_time, override_time, max_retry_count, exec_timeout, disabled, extend_json
mapper.select: select dci.id as mainId, dcid.id, dcid. create_time, dcid.update_time, dcid.create_user_name, dcid.create_user_id, dcid.update_user_name, dcid.update_user_id, dcid.version, dcid.is_deleted, dcid.main_id, dcid.next_level_id, dcid.last_time, dcid.next_time, dcid.interval_time, dcid.override_time, dcid.max_retry_count, dcid.exec_timeout, dcid.disabled, dcid.extend_json from dmp_basic_system abs inner join dmp_cfg_input dci on abs.id = dci.system_id and dci.is_deleted = false left join dmp_cfg_input_detail dcid on dci.id = dcid.main_id and dcid.is_deleted = false where dcid.is_deleted = false and abs.code = #{cfgOptionDTO.system} and dci.code = #{cfgOptionDTO.code} and dcid.next_level_id = #{cfgOptionDTO.nextLevelId}
